raw_data_contract.historical: data/ha_d1/layers/01_raw_exchange_observations/*.parquet: raw NSE EQ OHLCV; join canonical identity from data/ha_d1/layers/02_security_identity_history using dated ISIN mapping
raw_data_contract.live: Add immutable daily NSE bhavcopy EQ OHLCV snapshot ingestion using existing ha_data_foundation parser. Yahoo auto-adjusted bars are not admissible; fail closed when authoritative raw bar is absent.
raw_data_contract.identity: ISIN canonical security ID, dated NSE symbol; exclude unresolved IDs
raw_data_contract.adjustment: NONE; raw split-day jumps remain explicit; quarantine any security for 20 observed sessions after abs(raw close return)>=40%; apply identically historical/live
raw_data_contract.history_seed: First archived observation, persisted state from then onward; do not truncate/reseed EWM at live activation
raw_data_contract.universe: Reconstruct current frozen qualification on these exact raw bars for each T. No future membership. Rank over this entire qualified set before allocation; do not mix existing adjusted-bar qualified identities.
raw_data_contract.benchmark: NSE Nifty 500 completed-session close, same archived/live source; no substitution; missing benchmark features NaN
raw_data_contract.timestamp: as_of_session T and source publication/ingestion time <= decision timestamp; freeze payload and SHA; T+1 never read by feature code
raw_data_contract.traded_value_proxy: raw close * raw shares explicitly named proxy, not exchange turnover
raw_data_contract.india_vix: removed; do not replace with realized volatility

targets.reference: raw close at T; next 10 NSE sessions; complete bars required
targets.success_5_before_3: first high>=1.05*C[T] strictly before first low<=0.97*C[T]; same-session tie fails
targets.adverse_first: -3 reached and +5 not reached earlier; tie adverse; neither reached=>false
targets.corporate_actions: Exclude outcome windows crossing known split/bonus ex-dates; use outcomes only for label eligibility, never feature universe. Persist exclusions.

split_protocol.historical_evaluation: 2024-2026 already examined by PB/Path Risk; disclosed reused evaluation, not globally untouched; annual base before Y-2, calibration Y-2..Y-1, labels end strictly before Y
split_protocol.embargo: 20 trading sessions before each partition boundary in addition to label-end purge; no random split
split_protocol.future_test: Freeze before new prospective collection; minimum 12 months and 1000 matured qualified recommendations, >=3 strategies and >=100 sessions; no authority until separate review
split_protocol.autopaper: Do not open/replay AutoPaper holdout or evaluate its policies

model_selection.regression: Ridge alpha=10, training medians, standard scaling, missing indicators; raw or log1p magnitude, max2 per target
model_selection.classification: L2 logistic C=1 liblinear, same preprocessing; constant prevalence baseline if single class
model_selection.calibration: none vs affine for regressions; none vs Platt for classification on calibration partition only
model_selection.selection: validation MAE (regression), Brier (classification), ties choose simpler; freeze once; no threshold search after evaluation
model_selection.numerical: finite deterministic inference artifact; no runtime fit; tolerance1e-10

baselines: original frozen PB-R2 archived performance on common identities where possible; report different population/source explicitly
evaluation.promotion: research GO only if beats unconditional MAE/Brier in >=2/3 annual folds with same-direction bucket differences in >=3 strategies; decision authority requires separately authorized prospective gate

pb_r3b.floor: 10th percentile abs(MAE prediction) in calibration predictions, lower bound1e-6; frozen before validation
pb_r3b.buckets: calibration ratio tertiles; LOW/MIDDLE/HIGH; freeze per annual artifact, never reuse PB-R3 thresholds
pb_r3b.validation: report realized MFE/MAE and success/adverse by bucket, N, missingness, fold/strategy stability; no gate/score/ranking
